title: Add personalized dashboard for returning visitors

requirements.text: Add a personalized dashboard section that is visible only to authenticated users (logged in via Internet Identity). The dashboard should display a welcome message with the user's principal ID and provide placeholders or tracked data for user activity (e.g., last login, pages visited) and saved preferences.

quotes: personalized dashboard so returning visitors can see their activity or saved preferences

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard section is only rendered when a user is authenticated via Internet Identity
Dashboard displays a personalized welcome message referencing the authenticated user
Dashboard shows at least one activity metric (e.g., visit count or last login timestamp) stored per principal in the backend
Dashboard shows at least one saved preference that the user can set and retrieve across sessions
Unauthenticated users do not see the dashboard section
Data is persisted in the Motoko backend actor keyed by user principal

requirements.text: Update the backend Motoko actor to store and retrieve per-user data: visit count (incremented on each authenticated session), last login timestamp, and at least one user-configurable preference (e.g., a display name or preferred contact topic). Expose query and update functions for the frontend to call.

quotes: personalized dashboard so returning visitors can see their activity or saved preferences

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores a record per Principal with fields: visitCount (Nat), lastLogin (Int timestamp), and a preference field (Text)
Backend exposes an update function to record a login/visit and increment visit count
Backend exposes a query function to retrieve the user's stored data by Principal
Backend exposes an update function to save a user preference

requirements.text: Add a React Query hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to fetch the authenticated user's dashboard data from the backend, and a mutation hook to update preferences. Integrate these hooks into the dashboard UI component.

quotes: personalized dashboard so returning visitors can see their activity or saved preferences

acceptanceCriteria: useQueries.ts exports a hook that fetches user dashboard data using the authenticated actor
A mutation hook is available to update saved preferences
Dashboard component uses these hooks and displays loading and error states appropriately
Data refreshes automatically after a preference is updated

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All backend logic must remain in the single-actor backend/main.mo file
Dashboard must only be accessible to authenticated users — no data exposure to anonymous principals
nonGoals: Third-party analytics or external tracking services
Social login or any authentication method other than Internet Identity
Real-time updates or WebSocket-based live data
